title: Laurentide's In-Demand Occupations Order, 2027: the Schedule A occupations that meet the test
decision: which Schedule A occupations the Bureau certifies for the 2027 In-Demand Occupations Order, with the Employer Services referral figures for the Minister's briefing

distractor_reasons.target/lfs_employment_by_occupation_laur: employment by broad occupational category (one digit of NOC 2021), not by unit group, and neither vacancies nor registered jobseekers: the order's test uses neither employment nor a vacancy rate
distractor_reasons.target/online_job_postings_index_laurent: an index of online postings across many job sites, seasonally adjusted and by broad category: postings advertised, not positions unfilled on the reference dates, and with no level to share the survey's totals by
